set_size.Description: Number of items presented in each trial of the memory task.

presented_color_degree.Description: Degree of presented color on a circular color space.

reported_color_degree.Description: Degree of the reported color on a circular color space.

non_target_color.Description: Non-target colors shown on the trial.

non_target_color_degree.Description: Comma-separated list of the non-target colour values on the circular colour space, in degrees.

target_color_degree.Description: Target color degree on the circular color space.
